command:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import ast, copy, hashlib, json, runpy, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

root = Path.cwd()
stage = root / "tasks/portal-background-session-20261019/evidence/active-cutoff-fix-20261024"
helper = stage / "compare-results.py"
validator_path = stage / "validate-implementation.py"
resume_path = stage / "setup/execute-resume.py"
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())
inventory = load(stage / "case-inventory.json")
original_case = next(case for case in inventory["cases"] if case["id"] == "E2E-07")
original_result_path = stage / original_case["candidate_result"]["path"]
original_result = load(original_result_path)
original_run = load(stage / original_case["candidate_run"]["path"])
resume = runpy.run_path(str(resume_path))
rows = []
assert any(event.get("event") == "visibilitychange" and event.get("visibility") == "hidden"
           for event in original_result["controlLifecycle"]["events"])
scenarios = [
    ("hidden-control-normal-failure", "FAILED", True, "EXECUTION_ERROR", False),
    ("hidden-control-raw-passed", "PASSED", True, "EXECUTION_ERROR", False),
    ("visible-control-business-failure", "FAILED", False, "FAILED", True),
]
for name, status, hidden, expected_outcome, expected_eligible in scenarios:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="natural-control-probe-") as temporary:
        trial = Path(temporary).resolve()
        fixture = trial / "source/native/probe"
        artifacts = fixture / "artifacts"
        artifacts.mkdir(parents=True)
        raw = copy.deepcopy(original_result)
        raw["status"] = status
        raw["error"] = ("The paired control must remain visible." if hidden and status == "FAILED"
                        else None if status == "PASSED"
                        else "Synthetic business recovery assertion failure.")
        if not hidden:
            raw["controlLifecycle"]["events"] = [
                event for event in raw["controlLifecycle"]["events"]
                if not (event.get("event") == "visibilitychange" and event.get("visibility") == "hidden")]
        run = copy.deepcopy(original_run)
        run["status"], run["error"] = status, raw["error"]
        result_path, run_path = artifacts / "result.json", fixture / "run.json"
        result_path.write_text(json.dumps(raw, indent=2) + "\n")
        run_path.write_text(json.dumps(run, indent=2) + "\n")
        for screenshot in raw["screenshots"]:
            shutil.copyfile(original_result_path.parent / screenshot["file"], artifacts / screenshot["file"])
        case = {key: copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in original_case.items()
                if not key.startswith("candidate_")
                and key not in {"transition", "comparison_valid", "evidence_validity", "reason_code",
                                "validity_basis", "validity_source"}}
        for key in ["prior_run", "prior_result"]:
            case[key]["path"] = str((stage / case[key]["path"]).resolve())
        (trial / "case-inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "cases": [case], "total_cases": 1, "baseline_counts": {"FAILED": 1}}))
        (trial / "progress.json").write_text("{}\n")
        input_hashes = {"run": sha(run_path), "result": sha(result_path)}
        command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(helper), "--record", "E2E-07",
                   "--run", str(run_path), "--result", str(result_path), "--evidence-root", str(trial)]
        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
        assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
        selected = load(trial / "case-inventory.json")["cases"][0]
        summary = json.loads(completed.stdout)
        validator = runpy.run_path(str(validator_path))
        validator["case_eligibility"].__globals__["STAGE"] = trial
        direct_classification = validator["classify"]("E2E-07", status, raw)
        eligibility = validator["case_eligibility"](selected)
        resume_eligible = resume["eligible"](selected)
        retained = trial / selected["candidate_result"]["path"]
        assert selected["candidate_business_outcome"] == expected_outcome
        assert selected["comparison_valid"] is expected_eligible
        assert selected["evidence_validity"] == ("VALID" if expected_eligible else "INVALID_COMPARISON")
        assert direct_classification == expected_outcome
        assert eligibility["eligible"] is expected_eligible
        assert resume_eligible is expected_eligible
        assert input_hashes == {"run": sha(run_path), "result": sha(result_path)}
        assert sha(retained) == input_hashes["result"]
        assert summary["business_passes"] == 0
        assert summary["candidate_counts"] == {expected_outcome: 1}
        stale_marker_check = None
        if hidden:
            assert selected["reason_code"] == "INVALID_VISIBLE_CONTROL"
            assert "cleanup" not in selected["validity_basis"].lower()
            misleading = copy.deepcopy(selected)
            misleading.update(candidate_business_outcome=status, comparison_valid=True, evidence_validity="VALID")
            misleading["candidate_attempts"][-1].update(
                business_outcome=status, comparison_valid=True, evidence_validity="VALID")
            stale_marker_check = validator["case_eligibility"](misleading)
            assert not stale_marker_check["eligible"]
        rows.append({
            "case": name, "status": "PASSED", "synthetic_raw_status": status,
            "synthetic_raw_error": raw["error"], "control_hidden": hidden,
            "expected_outcome": expected_outcome, "helper_outcome": selected["candidate_business_outcome"],
            "helper_comparison_valid": selected["comparison_valid"],
            "helper_evidence_validity": selected["evidence_validity"],
            "helper_reason_code": selected.get("reason_code"), "helper_validity_basis": selected.get("validity_basis"),
            "validator_direct_classification": direct_classification,
            "validator_eligibility": eligibility, "resume_eligible": resume_eligible,
            "misleading_valid_markers_rejected": stale_marker_check,
            "business_passes": summary["business_passes"],
            "temporary_raw_and_retained_hashes_equal": True,
            "temporary_cli": command, "exit_code": completed.returncode,
            "stderr": completed.stderr, "temporary_fixture_removed_on_exit": True,
        })
validator = runpy.run_path(str(validator_path))
actual_eligibility = [validator["case_eligibility"](case) for case in inventory["cases"]]
eligible_ids = [case["id"] for case in actual_eligibility if case["eligible"]]
pending_ids = [case["id"] for case in actual_eligibility if not case["eligible"]]
assert len(eligible_ids) == 16
assert pending_ids == ["E2E-06", "E2E-07", "E2E-15", "E2E-16", "E2E-19", "E2E-21"]
assert not resume["eligible"](original_case)
assert not resume["eligible"](next(case for case in inventory["cases"] if case["id"] == "E2E-06"))
syntax = []
for path in [helper, validator_path, resume_path]:
    ast.parse(path.read_text())
    syntax.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(stage)), "status": "PASSED", "sha256": sha(path)})
paths = [stage / name for name in [
    "case-inventory.json", "progress.json", "transitions.json", "counterfactual/case-inventory.json",
    "counterfactual/progress.json", "counterfactual/transitions.json"]]
paths += [root / ".workbench/session-active-cutoff-fix-20261024/sessionRenewal.original.cjs",
          root / "tasks/portal-background-session-20261019/06-test-cases.md"]
for subtree in ["browser", "counterfactual/browser"]:
    paths.extend(path for path in (stage / subtree).rglob("*") if path.is_file())
paths.extend(root / "repos/ui/mfe-base" / name for name in [
    "src/pages/Home/common/useController.ts", "src/pages/Home/common/sessionRefresh.test.tsx",
    "src/pages/Home/common/sessionLifecycle.test.tsx"])
protected = {str(path.relative_to(root)): sha(path) for path in sorted(set(paths))}
print(json.dumps({
    "recorded_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "status": "PASSED", "cases": rows,
    "syntax": syntax, "real_checkpoint": {"eligible_count": len(eligible_ids),
    "eligible_ids": eligible_ids, "pending_ids": pending_ids, "old_invalid_cross_and_natural_rejected": True},
    "protected_after": protected,
    "protected_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(protected, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest(),
    "business_execution_performed": False,
}, indent=2))
